'''Atoans''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Near-Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Atoan system]].

==Biology==
Atoans possessed an outward appearance that resembled baseline [[Human/Legends|Humans]], though their internal structure lacked a centralized [[Heart/Legends|heart]]; rather Atoans possessed thousands of smaller hearts evenly distributed throughout their bodies, from feet to fingertips.<ref name="TLC2">[[Darth Vader and the Lost Command 2|''Darth Vader and the Lost Command'' 2]]</ref> These hearts made the Atoans faster and stronger than humans, but also meant they could bleed to death more easily.<ref name="TLC2" /> Like Humans,<ref name="Star Wars: Darth Vader: A 3-D Reconstruction Log">''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader: A 3-D Reconstruction Log]]''</ref> Atoans had [[Lung/Legends|lungs]], a cranial cavity, and a [[sternum]].<ref name="TLC2" />

==History==
Atoans were native to [[Atoa/Legends|Atoa]], a planet of the [[Atoan system]], and by [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], they had expanded their civilization to other planets in the system, having a presence on a [[Atoan tar-pit planet|tar-pit planet]] <ref name="TLC2" /><ref name="Darth Vader and the Lost Command 3">[[Darth Vader and the Lost Command 3|''Darth Vader and the Lost Command'' 3]]</ref> and a [[Atoan crystal planet|crystal planet]]<ref name="TLC2" /><ref name="Darth Vader and the Lost Command 4">[[Darth Vader and the Lost Command 4|''Darth Vader and the Lost Command'' 4]]</ref>. In that same year the Atoans started an [[Atoan insurgency|insurgency]] against the newly founded [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], which had little information regarding their civilization.<ref name="DV1" />

===Atoan insurgency===
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] [[Garoche Tarkin]] defected from the Empire to [[Atoa/Legends|Atoa]] in part due to a deep resentment of the atrocities he had to commit in the name of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], and aided in their [[Atoan insurgency|insurgency]] along with Lady [[Saro]], the High Priestess of Atoa. The pair became lovers, and Saro conceived his child. Captain [[Shale (human)|Shale]] also joined in his defection, with the former seeking to kill Lord Vader, but failed. He later appeared with Saro and persuaded Vader to repent his sins. Vader ultimately killed them both in an attempted [[Death/Legends|suicide]] by [[Ambush on the Atoan crystal planet|collapsing the cathedral]] they were in, in order to atone for his sins as Vader. However, he ultimately survived. After the death of the Atoans’ political leaders, the Atoan system was conquered by the Empire. Garoche's end at the hands of Darth Vader was kept secret; his death was instead blamed on the Atoan Insurgents, as part of a plan by the Emperor to deepen [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin's]] hatred of any form of insurgency and make him a better tool of the Empire.<ref name="Darth Vader and the Lost Command 5">[[Darth Vader and the Lost Command 5|''Darth Vader and the Lost Command'' 5]]</ref>

==Culture and technology==
Atoan civilization was ruled by a [[theocracy]], where head figures were known as High Priestesses. They believed in the [[Twenty-nine Atoan gods]].<ref name="TLC2" />

Despite being native from the same [[Ghost Nebula/Legends|sector]] as [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbarans]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>, Atoans spoke their [[Atoan language|native language]] rather than [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]]. This language was considerd untranslatable, and even [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]] could only understand the general meaning of a given Atoan phrase.<ref name="DV1" /><ref name="Darth Vader and the Lost Command 3" /> The [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Saro]] learned to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] after killing a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] and eating his [[Tongue/Legends|tongue]].<ref name="TLC2" />

They were an advanced species, having at their disposal [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], [[Atoan starfighter|starfighters]] and floating cities located on a [[Atoan tar-pit planet|tar-pit planet]].<ref name="TLC2" /><ref name="Darth Vader and the Lost Command 3">[[Darth Vader and the Lost Command 3|''Darth Vader and the Lost Command'' 3]]</ref>
